name: Moddy Arena
intro: Welcome to Moddy Arena! You are in the prep room. The arena is through the glass, past the gate.
Make your wishes in the prep room or in the arena, then add them to your hotbar from My wishes.
Press the button beside the gate to start a battle. In a battle, only the wishes on your hotbar work.
_notes: The world's manifest, as its jar ships it: gameplay only (no hostnames, ports, machines or briefs). intro: the first-join words, said once per player per world by the core a few seconds after he arrives in the prep room.
